citations.title: Marketplace Payment Solutions Compared (2026): Providers & Selection

answer_text_markdown:
For most marketplaces, Stripe Connect is the best payments API overall.

It is purpose-built for marketplace payment flows, rather than simply processing credit cards. It handles seller onboarding, identity verification, split payments, platform commissions, refunds, and seller payouts.

However, the best choice depends on your marketplace's business model, geography, and transaction volume.

Top 5 marketplace payment APIs
------------------------------

1\. Stripe Connect

Best overall

*   Excellent developer experience and documentation.
    
*   Built-in seller onboarding and KYC.
    
*   Split payments and application fees.
    
*   Automated seller payouts.
    
*   Strong ecosystem of integrations.
    

Website: [Stripe Connect](https://stripe.com/connect?utm_source=chatgpt.com)   \[1\]

2\. Adyen for Platforms

Best for enterprise

*   Excellent international payment infrastructure.
    
*   Flexible split payments.
    
*   Sophisticated risk management.
    
*   Strong global acquiring capabilities.
    
*   Better suited to established, high-volume platforms.
    

Website: [Adyen for Platforms](https://www.adyen.com/platforms?utm_source=chatgpt.com)   \[2\]

3\. Mangopay

Best for wallets and escrow

*   Designed specifically for marketplaces.
    
*   Seller wallets and fund allocation.
    
*   Multi-party payment flows.
    
*   Particularly interesting for European marketplaces.
    

Website: [Mangopay](https://mangopay.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)   \[3\]

4\. PayPal Commerce Platform

*   Recognizable checkout experience.
    
*   Marketplace payment capabilities.
    
*   Global buyer reach.
    
*   Useful for marketplaces where PayPal adoption matters.
    

Website: [PayPal Commerce Platform](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/platforms-and-marketplaces?utm_source=chatgpt.com)   \[4\]

5\. Airwallex

*   Multi-currency payment infrastructure.
    
*   International seller payouts.
    
*   Foreign exchange capabilities.
    
*   Interesting for cross-border marketplaces.
    

Website: [Airwallex](https://www.airwallex.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)   \[5\]

These comparisons reflect current 2026 marketplace offerings.

\[6, 7, 8, 9\]

Comparison
----------

| Feature | Stripe Connect | Adyen | Mangopay |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Seller onboarding | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Split payments | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Platform commissions | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Seller payouts | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Wallet infrastructure | Limited | Balance accounts | Core feature |
| Startup friendly | Excellent | Moderate | Moderate |
| Enterprise scalability | Excellent | Excellent | Excellent |

What I'd recommend
------------------

If I were building a new marketplace today:

*   Startup / MVP: Stripe Connect.
    
*   Multi-vendor marketplace: Stripe Connect.
    
*   Escrow-heavy marketplace: Mangopay.
    
*   Large international marketplace: Adyen.
    
*   Cross-border marketplace: Airwallex.
    

One important consideration: don't build your own escrow or money-holding infrastructure without understanding the applicable financial regulations. Let an appropriately licensed payments provider handle the regulated money movement.

Let me narrow this down to the best API for your marketplace
------------------------------------------------------------

There are four things that would change my recommendation.

With those answers, I can recommend the actual payment infrastructure, including the API, onboarding model, commission handling, split-payment architecture, and payout system.
